in_marathi.name: Jagatkar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jagatkar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jagatkar is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'jagat' meaning 'world' and 'kar' meaning 'doer'. It is believed that the name refers to the supreme god who is the creator and sustainer of the universe. Jagatkar is a revered name in Hinduism and is given to boys as a mark of respect and devotion.
